mapper.sql: id, name, server_id, template_id, collect_script, params, threshold_rule, cron_expression, alarm_channels, alarm_template_id, is_active, last_run_time, last_run_status, last_run_value, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.server_id, t.template_id, t.collect_script, t.params, t.threshold_rule, t.cron_expression, t.alarm_channels, t.is_active, t.last_run_time, t.last_run_status, t.last_run_value, t.create_time, t.update_time, s.name as server_name, s.ip as server_ip, m.name as template_name FROM server_monitor_task t LEFT JOIN server_asset s ON t.server_id = s.id LEFT JOIN monitor_template m ON t.template_id = m.id ORDER BY t.id DESC

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.server_id, t.template_id, t.collect_script, t.params, t.threshold_rule, t.cron_expression, t.alarm_channels, t.is_active, t.last_run_time, t.last_run_status, t.last_run_value, t.create_time, t.update_time, s.name as server_name, s.ip as server_ip, m.name as template_name FROM server_monitor_task t LEFT JOIN server_asset s ON t.server_id = s.id LEFT JOIN monitor_template m ON t.template_id = m.id WHERE t.server_id = #{serverId} ORDER BY t.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO server_monitor_task(name, server_id, template_id, collect_script, params, threshold_rule, cron_expression, alarm_channels, alarm_template_id, is_active) VALUES(#{name}, #{serverId}, #{templateId}, #{collectScript}, #{params}, #{thresholdRule}, #{cronExpression}, #{alarmChannels}, #{alarmTemplateId}, #{isActive})
